jobs.occupation: Gen B Graduate Program, Process & Metallurgy Engineer
jobs.description:
Start your future at one of Europe’s leading mining- and smelting companies and become part of Gen B! Begin a one-year journey designed to challenge and inspire you. As a graduate, you will gain in-depth, hands-on experience across different business areas, functions, and sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Portugal or Ireland, depending on your chosen position. 
 
To drive change for future generations, we need new ways of thinking, that’s why we encourage you to apply. You are the hearts behind tomorrow.  
 
A program designed for your future 
For one year, divided into three periods, you will explore how Boliden operates end to end, and how your own unique background and experience connect to the bigger picture. As a graduate, you are employed in a permanent position from day one and supported by an individual development program. Throughout the year several engaged and experienced colleagues, will guide you in your progress. You will become part of an international network of graduates and colleagues, expanding both your knowledge and connections. Six joint training weeks with top-class lecturers will challenge your thinking and give you the opportunity to further deepen your skills. After graduation you will continue your journey with a mentor for six months. In addition, you will receive practical training in project methodology and Boliden’s production methods, enabling you to apply what you learn directly in our operations. 
 
Learn more how you can step into a future where raw material meets your potential.  
 
Find your path 
As a graduate and part of Gen B, you will be given a unique gateway into Boliden. Whether you want to grow as an expert in business, engineering or tech, you will get the opportunity to grow in the area that excites you the most.  
In this role as a Process & Metallurgy Engineer, you'll be part of a process engineering team, working collaboratively to monitor and improve process performance in the concentrators. You will investigate process issues, work with improving metal recovery and concentrate quality, and contribute to development initiatives and projects while considering the financial impact of process performance. 

Responsibilities: 
Monitor and follow up process performance and results 

Troubleshoot process issues and identify improvement opportunities 

Work to improve production recovery and concentrate quality 

Consider the financial impact of process performance and improvements 

Participate in development initiatives and projects within the concentrators

 
Collaborate with process engineering colleagues on process-related work 

Build understanding of industrial processes through hands-on work in the plant and production environment 

 Qualifications: 
University degree in process technology, chemical engineering, mining engineering, mineral engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree is preferred 

 
Who you are 
We think you are a forward thinker and a team thriver, who is naturally curious, and solutions oriented. You communicate with honesty and respect, are eager to take initiative and dedicated to follow through. Above all, you are ready to take responsibility and grow as an expert. 

What you bring 
You hold a relevant university degree completed in 2025 or later. You can communicate clearly in English, hold a valid driver’s license and are available to start in September 2027. 
 This role may be based in Sweden, Finland or Portugal. The final location will be determined during the recruitment process, based on business needs.  

How to apply 
Submit your application and CV in English. The recruitment process includes assessments, interviews, and a final Assessment Center for selected candidates.  
The Assessment Center will take place in Stockholm, Sweden, on one day between February 16-19, 2027. Boliden will cover travel and accommodation expenses. Please ensure your availability between February 14-20, 2027, if you progress to the final stage 

About Boliden 
Boliden is at the forefront of advancing our industry through sustainable solutions and innovation. Every day, we work to reduce our footprint and drive long-term progress. We are on a journey towards becoming the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. With us, you will be part of a diverse workplace built on care, courage, and responsibility. We work together to grow and take the lead. Our priority is your safety, well-being, and growth. Make a lasting impact, in your everyday work, for future generations. Let a rock-solid career start with us.
Learn more at www.boliden.com. 

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful! 
Do you have any questions about your application? Please send a e-mail to genb@boliden.com.
The last day to apply for this position is November 17th 2026. Selection will be ongoing; we are looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible. 
 
Union information for Sweden is available from Ingela Scherling, Saco +46 70 272 08 68, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70 541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910 77 40 09.  
 
If you are a representative of a recruiting firm, please refrain from contacting us about this posting. We appreciate your consideration.

Marketing Associate Student to Amazon
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking a student to join its core consumer business team, working on projects to expand product selection, drive demand, optimize the supply chain, enhance customer experience, and improve processes. Read more below and apply today!
About the role
As a working student, you will be assigned a mentor to support you in your work. In addition to learning about a significant project, you will have the opportunity to interact with Amazon employees for both personal and professional development. You will also be able to expand your network and participate in activities with other working students to learn about the advertising portfolio or commerce services and Amazon culture.
Work tasks
Understand customer challenges, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered through advertising or commerce services
Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools
Identify goals through market data and industry intelligence
Analyze and extract insights from data using Excel and SQL
Develop/manage homepage content, campaigns, events, etc
Present your work to stakeholders at all levels

We are looking for
Language: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as the language is used daily

Skills: Experience in similar roles and/or knowledge of SQL.

Communicative
Meticulous
Analytical

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: Norwegian Customer Consultant in Torrevieja, Spain
jobs.description:
We are now looking for customer-focused employees for our clients office in Torrevieja!
We are searching for those who work well independently and are passionate about delivering excellent service to our customers. Our customers may find themselves in vulnerable situations and it is important to us that they receive the right assistance. As a customer consultant, you will work as part of a larger team that helps and supports each other when needed.
As a customer consultant, your tasks will involve receiving and responding to phone inquiries from our customers who need roadside assistance. To accomplish this, you will work as a customer consultant in various systems to solve the challenges as effectively as possible. Additionally, you will assist our partners in the insurance and automotive industry with various questions related to roadside assistance.
To succeed in this role, we would like you to possess the following skills:
Experience in customer service would be an advantage
Fluent in Norwegian, both spoken and written
Proficient in English, both spoken and written
Good knowledge of data/technology

In terms of personal qualities, you are ideally someone who values good work ethics and has strong teamwork skills. You excel in communication and are comfortable working both individually and in a team, as well as being at ease with data and the phone as work tools. As a person, you are likely solution-oriented and approachable, both with customers and colleagues. It is an advantage if you are curious and eager to acquire new knowledge - our days are very dynamic, and we are constantly evolving.
For the right candidates, we can offer:
Newly renovated offices with sea views in the center of Torrevieja
A great working environment with experienced and curious colleagues
Comprehensive and structured training and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development
A rotating schedule
Competitive conditions

We look forward to hearing from you! If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us at fredrik@jobsbynordics.com

jobs.occupation: Junior Developer: Data Center Automation
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 Are you curious about technology and excited to turn ideas into solutions that make a real difference?
 We are looking for a junior Developer who is eager to grow, learn, and help us bring more automation into our datacenter environments. You will join a team to develop smarter and more efficient workflows across our global datacenter sites, while ensuring our solutions align with Ericsson's security directives and frameworks. The team works together with operations and lifecycle management of server HW in the datacenter as well as creating automated workflows for other teams within our global datacenter operations.
 You will be part of our journey to make our datacenter environments smarter through automation. Working together with experienced colleagues, you will help automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and develop solutions that make our labs more efficient and reliable. You will also work hands-on in the datacenter, managing different server environments. It's a role where you can learn, experiment, take initiative, and grow your technical skills while contributing to real R&D challenges.

jobs.occupation: Automotive Cybersecurity Engineer – Software-Defined Vehicles
jobs.description:
Vehicles are increasingly defined by software: centralised computing, over-the-air updates and connected services. That makes cybersecurity a core part of vehicle development. Cyber Instincts is building a network of automotive cybersecurity specialists to take on assignments with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the Gothenburg region. If you work with product cybersecurity and want to help shape secure, software-defined vehicles, we’d like to hear from you.
What you could work on

Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA) at component, function and vehicle level

Defining cybersecurity goals, concepts and requirements together with architects and system designers

Securing software-defined vehicle architectures: central compute, zonal architectures and vehicle-to-cloud connectivity

Secure boot, secure software updates and OTA, key management and PKI

Supporting compliance with ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 and type approval

Supplier cybersecurity reviews and work product assessments

Vulnerability management and post-production cybersecurity monitoring

What we’re looking for

Experience in automotive or embedded cybersecurity

Hands-on experience with TARA and ISO/SAE 21434

Good understanding of UNECE R155/R156 and CSMS

Ability to work with architects, developers, suppliers and other stakeholders

Fluent English. Swedish is a plus.

It’s a plus if you have experience with

Software-defined vehicles: service-oriented architectures (SOA), AUTOSAR Adaptive, high-performance computers (HPC) and zonal architectures

Connected vehicles: OTA/SUMS, vehicle-to-cloud security, V2X and telematics

Embedded security: HSM, secure boot, SecOC, secure diagnostics (UDS 0x27/0x29) and cryptography

Platforms: AUTOSAR Classic, Linux/QNX and Android Automotive

Networks: CAN/CAN FD, automotive Ethernet, MACsec and IDS/IDPS

Secure development: secure software development, DevSecOps, SBOM and supply-chain security

Testing: security testing and penetration testing of ECUs and vehicle systems

Related standards: ISO 26262 (functional safety), ISO/SAE 21434 with China GB 44495, and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)

What we offer

Assignments with leading automotive companies in the Gothenburg region

The choice of employment at Cyber Instincts or working with us as an independent subconsultant

A small, specialised cybersecurity company with short decision paths and close contact with management

Location: Gothenburg. The setup is hybrid or on-site depending on the assignment.
We review applications continuously, and you are welcome to apply even if we have no matching assignment right now.

jobs.occupation: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Swedium Global Services is the growing System Engineering and Solution Company, offers services like Semiconductor Engineering R&D Services, Embedded Systems Development, Custom Application Software Development, Web and Cloud Application Development, Testing Services, Consultancy and Outsourcing services to our clients across the globe for an onsite and offshore business model. Swedium Global is having presence in Sweden, Finland, Poland, Czech Republic and in India.
Location - Onsite, Sweden
Job Title - Senior Hardware Design Engineer

We are looking for a senior Hardware Design Engineer having experience in BMS
Requirements
This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You will take battery subsystem requirements and turn them into robust BMS hardware solutions together with system engineers, cell specialists, software engineers and manufacturing experts

Your responsibilities
Derive hardware requirements from battery subsystem requirements and translate them into practical design choices.
Define BMS hardware architecture and functional blocks based on system architecture, requirements, standards and certification needs.
Create schematics and PCB designs in OrCAD, including symbols, footprints and production-ready documentation.
Define the BMS interfaces to the battery system and contribute to the optimal EE layout of the battery design.
Select electronic and electrical components with the right balance of performance, safety, availability and manufacturability.
Prepare manufacturing deliverables for PCBA production and support test, troubleshooting, verification and validation.
Define AFE parameters, operating modes and BMS functions in close collaboration with cell experts, system engineers and software engineers.
Specify the hardware–software interface together with the software team and ensure clear, structured technical documentation.

The technical landscape
You will work close to the product and close to the details. The role suits someone who enjoys circuit-level problem solving, knows the trade-offs in BMS hardware, and can move naturally between architecture, schematic design, PCBA realization, verification and cross-functional decision-making.

What we believe you bring
BSc or MSc in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience in electronics/hardware development.
Documented experience in hardware design for Battery Management Systems — this is essential.
Strong experience in circuit and PCBA design and the confidence to work independently in complex designs.
Hands-on experience with AFEs, MCUs and BMS-related hardware architectures.
At least 3 years of OrCAD experience for schematic and PCB design.
Fluent English, both spoken and written.
